paraphrase: Songs of the Siddhas overheard by Janaka: we worship the Self, the pure witness in which the seer, the seeing and the seen arise and dissolve, the bliss that is experienced when subject meets object without mental elaboration; those who seek anything else abandon the jewel in their hand.
